lines.explanation: The task is read-only (identify the workspace with a rocket-reacting member on the $47K cloud bill message). The agent located the correct message (msg 1706067472.000000, U_ROBERT, #core-infra, T01WORKSPACE) via search.messages, then checked reactions.get (twice, plus full=true) confirming only a 'fire' reaction from U_ROBERT exists, matching the seed data (message_reactions/1: fire from U_ROBERT) and the absence of any rocket reaction on that message (the only seed rocket reaction, message_reactions/0, is on a different message at ts 1706028105.000000). The agent also verified single-workspace scope via auth.test and users.list, and checked for duplicate/alternate messages via search.messages/search.all with multiple query variants, none revealing another candidate. The final answer correctly reports absence of a qualifying workspace and accurately states the actual reaction found is fire, not rocket. This matches the card's resolution mode of 'absent' for the referent set.
